may_contain: a documented integral representation and its domain
the integration variable and phase extraction rule
must_not_contain: the Airy normal form as a lookup result
benchmark-specific branches in the generic germ solver

required_pipeline: select a domain-valid representation with provenance
construct the local analytic germ at the turning point
retain exact Taylor coefficients and an explicit remainder obligation
select the leading Newton face without expected-scale hints
solve the exact rational balance constraints

controls: the same generic germ path passes a non-Bessel cubic phase
the same path passes a quartic cusp with two parameters
unsupported or domain-invalid representations fail with typed errors
baselines: record SymPy discovery behavior on the same raw input
record an executable Wolfram result when available; otherwise publish a precise non-executability boundary and do not infer a win

disposition.EXPAND: the complete raw-to-certificate pipeline passes and independent baseline evidence supports a new automation claim
disposition.NARROW: the pipeline passes but depends on a representation registry or competitive novelty is not established
disposition.STOP: the result requires expected-scale leakage, an uncertified hidden oracle, or cannot be independently replayed
